title: Kerala Highlands & Backwaters Escape
shortDescription: Experience Kerala's finest landscapes with misty mountains, wildlife, spice plantations, and a magical overnight stay on the serene Alleppey backwaters.
highlights: Scenic drive through waterfalls and tea estates
Wildlife safari and cultural experiences in Thekkady
Luxury overnight houseboat cruise in Alleppey
Comfortable hotels with private transfers throughout
overview: Escape into the heart of God's Own Country on this thoughtfully designed five-day journey through Kerala's most celebrated destinations. Wander through lush tea-covered hills in Munnar, discover fragrant spice plantations and wildlife in Thekkady, and unwind aboard a traditional houseboat gliding through the peaceful backwaters of Alleppey. With comfortable accommodations, curated sightseeing, authentic local experiences, and seamless private transportation, this itinerary is perfect for couples, families, and travelers seeking a relaxing yet immersive holiday.
pickupLocation: Kochi International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 2 nights in a premium 3/4-star hotel in Munnar, 1 night in a premium hotel at Thekkady, and 1 night aboard a deluxe AC houseboat in Alleppey on twin/triple sharing.
transportation: Private air-conditioned vehicle with professional driver for all airport transfers, intercity travel, and sightseeing.
meals: Breakfast on Days 2-5, plus Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner, and Breakfast during the Alleppey houseboat stay.
weather: Pleasant throughout the year. Munnar remains cool (12°C-24°C), while Thekkady and Alleppey are warm and tropical (22°C-33°C).

itinerary.title: Welcome to Kerala & Journey into the Hills
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Railway Station and meet your tour representative before beginning the scenic drive towards Munnar.
itinerary.afternoon: Pause along the route to admire cascading waterfalls, lush spice plantations, and breathtaking mountain viewpoints before continuing uphill.
itinerary.evening: Check into your hotel, relax after the journey, or explore the charming local market at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Explore the Beauty of Munnar
itinerary.morning: Visit Eravikulam National Park and enjoy spectacular views of rolling tea gardens while spotting the rare Nilgiri Tahr.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Lake, Tea Museum, and scenic viewpoints such as Echo Point and Top Station.
itinerary.evening: Return to the hotel after an optional boating experience or spend a peaceful evening enjoying the cool mountain weather.

itinerary.title: From Tea Hills to Spice Country
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, drive through picturesque valleys and plantations towards Thekkady.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, explore aromatic spice gardens, and browse local shops for authentic Kerala spices.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy a vibrant Kathakali dance performance or witness the traditional martial art of Kalaripayattu before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Houseboat Bliss in Alleppey
itinerary.morning: Drive to Alleppey and board a beautifully appointed traditional Kerala houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Cruise through tranquil canals, coconut groves, village landscapes, and paddy fields while enjoying freshly prepared local cuisine.
itinerary.evening: Watch a mesmerizing sunset over the backwaters before settling in for a peaceful overnight stay aboard the houseboat.
itinerary.mealsIncluded: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner

itinerary.title: Backwaters Farewell & Departure
itinerary.morning: Enjoy breakfast onboard before checking out of the houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive back to Kochi with time for optional sightseeing around Fort Kochi depending on your departure schedule.
itinerary.evening: Transfer to Kochi Airport or Railway Station with unforgettable memories of Kerala.

inclusions: Airport/Railway Station pickup and drop in Kochi
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
1 night stay in a deluxe AC houseboat at Alleppey
All meals during the houseboat experience
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to and from Kochi
Lunch and dinner during hotel stays unless specified
Personal expenses such as shopping, laundry, beverages, and tips
Adventure activities, boating charges, and optional experiences
Entry tickets, camera fees, and sightseeing charges not mentioned
Additional accommodation or transport due to delays, weather, or force majeure
Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions
packingList: Light jacket for cool evenings in Munnar

faq.question: What is the ideal season for this Kerala tour?
faq.answer: The trip operates throughout the year, but October to March offers the most comfortable weather for sightseeing and outdoor activities.

faq.question: Is the Alleppey houseboat air-conditioned?
faq.answer: Yes. The package includes an overnight stay in a deluxe air-conditioned houseboat with comfortable rooms and freshly prepared meals.

faq.question: Is this itinerary suitable for families and senior citizens?
faq.answer: Yes. The itinerary is relaxed, involves comfortable road travel, and is designed for families, couples, and senior travelers.

faq.question: Are entry tickets to attractions included?
faq.answer: Only permits specifically mentioned in the inclusions are covered. Other attraction entry tickets and optional activities are payable directly.

title: Kerala Weekend Escape
shortDescription: A refreshing Kerala getaway featuring misty hills, scenic waterfalls, lush tea plantations, and an unforgettable overnight houseboat experience in Alleppey.
highlights: Explore Munnar's tea gardens and mountain viewpoints
Relax aboard a traditional Alleppey houseboat
Visit iconic waterfalls and scenic landscapes
Private transfers with comfortable premium stays
overview: Perfect for travelers with limited time, this four-day Kerala escape combines the cool hills of Munnar with the tranquil backwaters of Alleppey. Journey through picturesque waterfalls, tea plantations, and breathtaking viewpoints before unwinding aboard a deluxe houseboat. Carefully planned with comfortable accommodations, seamless transportation, and authentic local experiences, this itinerary offers the perfect blend of nature, relaxation, and culture.
pickupLocation: Kochi International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Railway Station
accommodation: 2 nights in a premium 3-star/4-star hotel in Munnar and 1 night aboard a deluxe AC houseboat in Alleppey on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private air-conditioned sedan/SUV with experienced driver for all sightseeing and transfers.
meals: Breakfast from Day 2 onwards and all meals during the Alleppey houseboat stay (Lunch, Dinner & Breakfast).
weather: Munnar enjoys cool temperatures between 12°C-24°C, while Alleppey remains warm and tropical at 24°C-33°C throughout most of the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Journey to Munnar
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Railway Station before beginning your scenic drive into Kerala's highlands.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at beautiful waterfalls and enjoy panoramic views as you travel through spice plantations and winding mountain roads.
itinerary.evening: Check into your hotel in Munnar and spend a relaxed evening exploring nearby cafés or local markets.

itinerary.title: Discover the Best of Munnar
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Eravikulam National Park and admire the rolling tea estates surrounding the region.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Blossom Park, and other scenic attractions.
itinerary.evening: Return to the hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening amidst the cool mountain weather.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat Experience
itinerary.morning: Check out after breakfast and drive towards the enchanting backwaters of Alleppey.
itinerary.afternoon: Board your deluxe houseboat and enjoy a freshly prepared lunch while cruising through peaceful canals, paddy fields, and village landscapes.
itinerary.evening: Witness a spectacular sunset over the backwaters before enjoying dinner and an overnight stay aboard the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Return to Kochi & Departure
itinerary.morning: Enjoy breakfast onboard before disembarking from the houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive back to Kochi with an optional stop at Fort Kochi or Marine Drive if your departure schedule allows.
itinerary.evening: Transfer to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

faq.answer: Yes. This itinerary is designed for travelers looking to experience Kerala's highlights within four days.

faq.question: Can families with children join this trip?
faq.answer: Absolutely. The itinerary is family-friendly and suitable for couples, children, and senior citizens.

faq.answer: Fort Kochi sightseeing is optional on the final day and depends on your departure timing.

title: Gokarna & Dandeli Adventure Escape
shortDescription: An action-packed weekend combining thrilling river adventures, scenic beach hikes, waterfalls, temple visits, and serene mangrove boating along Karnataka's stunning coastline.
highlights: White-water rafting and adventure sports in Dandeli
Seven Beach coastal trek with breathtaking sunset views
Visit the iconic Murudeshwar Shiva Statue
Mangrove boating through Honnavar backwaters
overview: Escape into Karnataka's perfect blend of adventure and coastal beauty. Experience thrilling water sports in Dandeli, hike across hidden beaches in Gokarna, witness spectacular waterfalls, explore the iconic Murudeshwar Temple, and glide through the peaceful mangroves of Honnavar. Designed for adventure seekers and weekend travelers, this journey combines nature, adrenaline, spirituality, and unforgettable coastal experiences.
pickupLocation: Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Bengaluru, Pune (Train/Bus) with pickup from Hubballi
accommodation: 1 night cottage stay in Dandeli and 1 night premium AC villa near Murudeshwar Beach on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Train/Bus as per selected package, followed by local transfers in Tempo Traveller, Innova, or similar AC vehicle.
meals: 1 Breakfast, 1 Lunch, and 1 Dinner during the Dandeli stay (Veg & Non-Veg Buffet).
weather: Pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging between 20°C and 34°C. Best visited from October to March.

itinerary.title: Departure from Your City
itinerary.morning: Prepare for the overnight journey with all travel essentials.
itinerary.afternoon: Board your train or bus from your selected departure city.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy an overnight journey towards Hubballi while getting ready for the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Adventure Begins in Dandeli
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Hubballi, freshen up, enjoy breakfast, and drive towards Dandeli.
itinerary.afternoon: Experience exciting adventure activities including white-water rafting, kayaking, zorbing, swimming, and other optional water sports on the Kali River.
itinerary.evening: Relax at the riverside campsite with music, bonfire, delicious dinner, and an overnight cottage stay.

itinerary.title: Vibhuti Falls & Seven Beach Trail
itinerary.morning: Visit the scenic Vibhuti Falls and enjoy a short nature walk surrounded by lush greenery.
itinerary.afternoon: Embark on the famous Seven Beach Trek covering secluded beaches, dramatic cliffs, and scenic coastal trails with optional café hopping.
itinerary.evening: Watch a spectacular sunset at Om Beach before checking into your beachside villa near Murudeshwar for the night.

itinerary.title: Murudeshwar & Honnavar Exploration
itinerary.morning: Visit the magnificent Murudeshwar Temple and admire one of the world's tallest Shiva statues.
itinerary.afternoon: Relax at Eco Beach before enjoying a peaceful mangrove boating experience through the Honnavar backwaters.
itinerary.evening: Drive back to Hubballi and board your return train or bus with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Train/Bus travel as per selected package
Local transportation in Tempo Traveller/Innova or similar vehicle
1 night AC villa stay in Murudeshwar
Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner at Dandeli
Driver allowance, tolls, fuel, state taxes, and parking charges
exclusions: Adventure activities not mentioned in the inclusions
Expenses arising due to weather conditions, roadblocks, natural calamities, or public protests
Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions

faq.question: Is river rafting included in the package?
faq.answer: Yes. White-water rafting is included along with selected adventure activities mentioned in the itinerary.

faq.question: Do I need prior trekking experience?
faq.answer: No. The Seven Beach Trek is suitable for beginners with a reasonable level of fitness.

faq.question: What type of accommodation is provided?
faq.answer: The trip includes one riverside cottage stay in Dandeli and one premium AC villa stay near Murudeshwar Beach.

faq.question: Is this trip suitable for solo travelers?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Many solo travelers join this trip, making it a great opportunity to meet fellow adventure enthusiasts.

title: Coorg & Chikmagalur Explorer
shortDescription: Experience Karnataka's coffee hills, majestic waterfalls, mountain peaks, heritage temples, and wildlife on an exciting three-day getaway.
highlights: Sunrise at Mullayanagiri Peak
Jeep ride to Mandalpatti
Visit the Golden Temple & Belur Temple
Explore waterfalls, wildlife and coffee plantations
overview: Discover two of Karnataka's most beautiful hill destinations in one memorable journey. Wander through Coorg's lush coffee estates, witness the scenic beauty of Mandalpatti and Abbey Falls, stand atop Karnataka's highest peak at Mullayanagiri, admire the magnificent Hoysala architecture at Belur, and conclude with sightseeing in Mysuru. Perfect for nature lovers, families, couples, and adventure enthusiasts looking for a refreshing weekend escape.
accommodation: 2 Nights stay in comfortable hotel/resort on twin or triple sharing basis.
transportation: Train from Bengaluru followed by AC Tempo Traveller/Innova for local sightseeing and transfers.
weather: Pleasant throughout the year (12°C–28°C). October to March offers the best weather.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Coorg
itinerary.morning: Arrive at the pickup point and begin your journey to Coorg. Visit the famous Namdroling Golden Temple and admire its Tibetan architecture.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue towards Harangi Dam and enjoy scenic views before visiting the nearby Elephant Camp where you can observe elephants in their natural habitat.
itinerary.evening: Check into the resort, relax amidst nature, enjoy dinner and spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Coorg to Chikmagalur
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, enjoy an adventurous jeep ride to Mandalpatti Peak for breathtaking panoramic views of the Western Ghats.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit the beautiful Abbey Falls before driving towards Chikmagalur. Continue to Mullayanagiri Peak, the highest point in Karnataka, and enjoy spectacular mountain scenery.
itinerary.evening: Return to the hotel after sunset and enjoy dinner with fellow travellers.

itinerary.title: Belur Heritage & Mysuru
itinerary.morning: Visit the UNESCO-listed Belur Chennakesava Temple and admire the intricate Hoysala architecture.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive towards Mysuru for sightseeing covering major landmarks such as Mysore Palace (outside view), St. Philomena's Church, and local markets depending on time.
itinerary.evening: Return to Bengaluru with unforgettable memories of Karnataka's hills and heritage.

faq.question: Is the Mandalpatti Jeep Ride included?
faq.answer: The jeep ride may be included depending on the selected package. Please verify before booking.

faq.question: Is this trip suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The itinerary involves light walking and sightseeing, making it suitable for families and first-time travellers.

faq.question: What type of accommodation is provided?
faq.answer: Comfortable hotels or resorts on twin/triple sharing basis.

faq.question: Which season is best for this trip?
faq.answer: October to March offers the best weather, although the trip operates throughout the year.

Glass Bridge & Zipline adventure

itinerary.title: Adventure & Scenic Coorg

title: Complete Tamil Nadu Hills Expedition
location: Coimbatore • Ooty • Coonoor • Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu
shortDescription: Discover the best of Tamil Nadu's hill stations with an unforgettable journey through Coimbatore, Ooty, Coonoor, and Kodaikanal featuring tea gardens, waterfalls, lakes, forests, viewpoints, and colonial charm.
highlights: Explore Ooty, Coonoor & Kodaikanal in one trip
Visit Adiyogi Shiva Statue & Doddabetta Peak
Experience tea estates, waterfalls & pine forests
Boating at Ooty Lake & Kodai Lake
overview: Embark on the ultimate Tamil Nadu hill station adventure covering the region's most iconic destinations. From the spiritual ambiance of Coimbatore to the colonial charm of Ooty, the breathtaking viewpoints of Coonoor, and the serene beauty of Kodaikanal, this journey showcases everything that makes South India's mountains so special. Explore lush botanical gardens, tea plantations, mist-covered valleys, waterfalls, pine forests, scenic lakes, and panoramic viewpoints while enjoying comfortable accommodations and carefully planned sightseeing. Perfect for families, honeymoon couples, nature lovers, and photography enthusiasts looking for a complete Nilgiri and Palani Hills experience.
pickupLocation: Coimbatore International Airport / Coimbatore Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 2 Nights in a premium hotel in Ooty and 2 Nights in a premium hotel in Kodaikanal on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private AC Sedan, SUV or Tempo Traveller for airport transfers and sightseeing.
altitude: Ooty - 2,240 m | Coonoor - 1,850 m | Kodaikanal - 2,133 m
weather: Pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 24°C. Evenings are cool and ideal for sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Coimbatore & Ooty
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station. Visit the iconic 112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue at Isha Yoga Center and, if time permits, Marudhamalai Murugan Temple.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive through the scenic Nilgiri Ghat roads to Ooty while enjoying lush tea estates and mountain landscapes. Check into the hotel.
itinerary.evening: Visit Ooty Lake for an optional boat ride and explore Charing Cross Market for homemade chocolates, Nilgiri tea, spices, and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Ooty & Coonoor Exploration
itinerary.morning: Visit Doddabetta Peak followed by the Tea Factory & Tea Museum to learn about Nilgiri tea production.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Coonoor and explore Sim's Park, Lamb's Rock, and Dolphin's Nose, offering spectacular valley and tea plantation views.
itinerary.evening: Return to Ooty via scenic tea estates. Spend leisure time shopping or relaxing at a cozy hill café.

itinerary.title: Ooty to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: Visit Pine Forest, Shooting Point, Pykara Lake, and Pykara Waterfalls before checking out.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive towards Kodaikanal through picturesque valleys and countryside. Upon arrival, check into the hotel.
itinerary.evening: Relax with a peaceful walk around Kodai Lake or explore the bustling local market known for homemade chocolates and handcrafted souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Discover the Princess of Hill Stations
itinerary.morning: Visit Coaker's Walk, Green Valley View, Bryant Park, and the picturesque Kodai Lake with time for optional boating.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Pine Forest, and Moir Point for unforgettable mountain scenery.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy free time at the local cafés or relax amidst the cool weather before dinner.

itinerary.title: Final Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.morning: Visit Silver Cascade Falls, Kurinji Andavar Temple, Shenbaganur Museum, Upper Lake View, and Silent Valley View depending on departure timing.
itinerary.afternoon: Begin your return drive to Coimbatore while enjoying the scenic Western Ghats one last time.
itinerary.evening: Drop at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Tamil Nadu's beautiful hill stations.

inclusions: Pickup and drop from Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Boating charges at Ooty Lake, Kodai Lake and Pykara Lake
Entry tickets to monuments, parks and museums
Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions
packingList: Cash for shopping and local expenses

faq.answer: Yes. This itinerary covers Coimbatore, Ooty, Coonoor, and Kodaikanal, offering the best combination of sightseeing, nature, tea plantations, viewpoints, waterfalls, lakes, and cultural attractions in one trip.

faq.answer: Absolutely. The itinerary is designed to balance sightseeing, relaxation, scenic drives, and leisure time, making it ideal for couples, families, and groups.

faq.answer: October to June offers the most pleasant weather for sightseeing, while the monsoon season transforms the hills into lush green landscapes with spectacular waterfalls.

title: Ooty & Kodaikanal Grand Escape
shortDescription: Experience two of South India's most beautiful hill stations with scenic lakes, tea gardens, waterfalls, pine forests, and breathtaking mountain viewpoints.
highlights: Explore Ooty's gardens, lakes and tea estates
Witness panoramic views from Doddabetta Peak
Visit Pillar Rocks, Pine Forest & Guna Caves
Enjoy boating at Kodai Lake and walk along Coaker's Walk
overview: Discover the finest hill stations of Tamil Nadu on this carefully crafted four-day getaway. Begin your journey in Ooty, the Queen of Hill Stations, where lush tea plantations, colonial charm, and misty mountains create unforgettable memories. Continue to the serene landscapes of Kodaikanal, renowned for its pine forests, sparkling lake, dramatic viewpoints, and pleasant climate. Ideal for honeymooners, families, photographers, and nature lovers, this itinerary combines scenic beauty, relaxation, and local experiences into one unforgettable holiday.
pickupLocation: Coimbatore International Airport / Coimbatore Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 2 Nights in a premium hotel in Ooty and 1 Night in a premium hotel in Kodaikanal on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private AC Sedan, SUV or Tempo Traveller for all transfers and sightseeing.
weather: Cool and pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging between 10°C and 24°C. Evenings remain chilly, especially during winter.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Explore Ooty
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station and enjoy a scenic drive through the Nilgiri Hills to Ooty. Check into your hotel and freshen up before sightseeing.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit the Government Botanical Garden followed by the famous Government Rose Garden. Stroll through beautifully maintained flower beds and enjoy the pleasant hill weather.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy boating at Ooty Lake and explore Charing Cross Market for homemade chocolates, Nilgiri tea, spices, and handicrafts before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Discover the Best of Ooty
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Doddabetta Peak for panoramic views of the Nilgiri Hills. Continue to the Tea Factory & Museum to experience tea manufacturing and enjoy fresh tea tasting.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Pine Forest, Shooting Point, Pykara Lake and Pykara Waterfalls. Optional boating is available at Pykara Lake.
itinerary.evening: Return to Ooty and enjoy free time exploring cafés or shopping before dinner.

itinerary.title: Journey to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, check out and drive through scenic mountain roads towards Kodaikanal. En route enjoy picturesque valley views and lush countryside.
itinerary.afternoon: Upon arrival, visit Silver Cascade Falls, Bryant Park, and the famous Coaker's Walk overlooking the Palani Hills.
itinerary.evening: Spend your evening boating or cycling around Kodai Lake before exploring the local market known for handmade chocolates, eucalyptus oil, and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Green Valley View, Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Pine Forest, and Moir Point while enjoying breathtaking views of the surrounding valleys.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Kurinji Andavar Temple and Shenbaganur Museum (time permitting) before beginning your return journey to Coimbatore.
itinerary.evening: Drop at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Tamil Nadu's hill stations.

inclusions: Pickup and drop from Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Boating charges at Ooty and Kodai Lake

faq.question: Which hill station is colder, Ooty or Kodaikanal?
faq.answer: Both enjoy pleasant weather year-round, but Ooty is generally slightly cooler, especially during winter mornings and nights.

faq.question: Is this package suitable for honeymoon couples?
faq.answer: Yes. This itinerary is one of the most popular honeymoon packages, combining romantic lakes, scenic viewpoints, peaceful walks, and comfortable accommodations.
